# v3.27-dev

## Fixed

- **Expanding an OLX no longer lists the same sub-item twice.** A parent OLX records its sub-items by Training Title, and several Training Titles often map to a single Full Title — typically an import variant of the same course. The expanded list was keyed on Training Title, so each of those variants produced its own row: two rows with identical text, both opening the same page, and a sub-item count inflated to match (a parent with three sub-items reading "6 sub-items").

  Sub-items now collapse to **one row per Full Title**, exactly like the main list above them, and the count reflects what you actually see.

## Updated

- Each nested sub-item row now shows **how many Training Titles it covers** in the Titles column, where it previously showed a dash — the same meaning that column has on a top-level row, so a merged entry is visible as merged rather than looking identical to a single one.
- If the merged Training Titles disagree on Product or Function, the row lists every value rather than silently showing whichever one happened to be listed first.
